title: definitelybenny.dev showcase entry
description: Put this file at the root of a repo tagged with the 'showcase' topic. It is everything definitelybenny.dev says about the project.

id.description: Used in the page address (definitelybenny.dev/tools/<id>/) and in other projects' 'next'. Defaults to the repo name.

order.description: Lower comes first on the home page. Defaults to 999.

status.description: 'soon' shows only the question, blurred, as a teaser.

question.description: The question on the card. The project's headline.

game.description: Small label above the question, like 'Pokémon VGC · Showdown'.

name.description: The tool's name. Required when live.

note.description: A handwritten aside under the question.

tilt.description: How crooked the card sits at full chaos, like '-1.2deg'.

what.description: What it is, in two or three sentences. Required when live.

useWhen.description: Moments you'd reach for it. Required when live.

thenAsk.description: Follow-up questions to get people curious. Required when live.

links.description: Buttons. The repo link is added for you if it's missing.

primary.description: The filled green button. Use on one link.

next.description: id of the project whose question comes next. Defaults to the following project.

detail.description: The tool's own page. Each part is optional.

status.description: Green line above the title, like 'Live · Pokémon Showdown'.

figure.description: A picture beside the text. Image paths are files in this repo.

code.description: A short snippet. // comments and keywords are colored.
